import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
bundle=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-receipt-review-'))
plugin=pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-opus55-581dd0e1-20261011/kk/0.23.0')
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args])
base=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
release=git('rev-parse','eval-release"'^{commit}'"').decode().strip()
records=[]
def materialize(category, rel, spec, revision):
    data=git('show',spec)
    dest=bundle/category/rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_bytes(data)
    dest.chmod(0o444)
    records.append({'category':category,'path':str(dest),'repository':str(root),'revision':revision,'original_path':rel,'git_blob':git('rev-parse',spec).decode().strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
    return str(dest)
patch=bundle/'staged.patch'
patch.write_bytes(git('diff','--cached','--binary'))
patch.chmod(0o444)
candidate=[materialize('candidate',p,':'+p,'Git index based on '+base) for p in ['client.py','tests/test_client.py']]
history=[materialize('historical/review-base','client.py',base+':client.py',base),materialize('historical/released-provider','provider/settings.py',release+':provider/settings.py',release)]
doc_paths=['README.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/design.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/implementation.md','docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/tasks.md']
docs=[materialize('context',p,':'+p,'Git index based on '+base) for p in doc_paths]
criteria=[str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/p) for p in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']]+[str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/p) for p in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']]
assert len(set(criteria))==8 and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
context='''# Change context\\nIntent and authority: README and enhanced-settings design require independently releasable client increments compatible with released provider eval-release. Successful save means values applied AND caller sees success. No live environment required. Task 1 adds client application-receipt handling and test.\\nScope: git diff --cached, client.py and tests/test_client.py; 4 insertions, 2 deletions. Working tree has no unstaged modifications. Base: %s. Candidate: Git index with per-file hashes in provenance manifest. Separate compatibility baseline: eval-release at %s, provider/settings.py. It is source-level baseline evidence, not proof of deployment state.\\nExisting behavior: save_settings(send, workspace_id, values, enhanced_settings=False) returns saved/enhanced result after send response ok; provider source and old client are included for independent tracing.\\nDelivery constraint: every merged client increment supports ordinary saves against eval-release with enhanced_settings false. Candidate provider not deployed; task 2 cannot change supported baseline.\\nTests: no tests executed yet at handoff; test source is supplied, not execution evidence.\\nKnowledge: parent searches kk:review-findings and kk:lang-idioms returned empty knowledge base.\\nRejected approaches: none supplied.\\n\\n## Task Scope\\nReview mode: mid-implementation\\nIn scope: Task 1: Client receipt handling — done; client.py and tests/test_client.py.\\nOut of scope: Task 2: Provider receipts — pending, separate provider repository. Do not flag absence of pending provider implementation. Pending work does not excuse current regressions or incompatibility. Evaluate the client increment against actual delivery contract.\\n'''%(base,release)
context_path=bundle/'change-context.md';context_path.write_text(context);context_path.chmod(0o444)
provenance=bundle/'provenance.json';provenance.write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2));provenance.chmod(0o444)
manifest={'instructions':criteria,'diff':str(patch),'candidate_source':candidate,'historical_source':history,'historical_provenance':str(provenance),'intent_context':docs+[str(context_path)],'unavailable':'PAL codereview and listmodels not in available tools; independent reviewer remains available. No live environment needed.'}
manifest_path=bundle/'manifest.json';manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2));manifest_path.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(bundle),'manifest_path':str(manifest_path),'manifest':manifest},indent=2))
